'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Ukraine]] claims responsibility for the downing of a [[Russia]]n [[Beriev A-50]] over [[Krasnodar Krai]], Russia, which is their second downing of an A-50 this year. [https://kyivindependent.com/russian-a50-plane-shot-down-over-azov-sea-military-says/ (Kyiv Independent)] [https://www.businessinsider.com/ukraine-claims-shot-down-a-50-russian-spy-plane-again-2024-2 (Business Insider)] 
*[[War in Amhara]]
**An [[Ethiopian Air Force|Ethiopian]] airstrike kills at least 15 people and injures more than 20 others in [[North Shewa Zone (Amhara)|North Shewa]], [[Ethiopia]], with many of the victims fleeing clashes between [[Fano (militia)|Fano]] and the Ethiopian government. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/airstrike-ethiopias-amhara-kills-least-15-civilians-residents-say-2024-02-23/ (Reuters)] [https://www.theeastafrican.co.ke/tea/rest-of-africa/airstrike-in-ethiopia-s-amhara-kills-at-least-15-civilians-4534866 (The East African)]
*A [[high-altitude balloon]] is detected over the [[Western United States]], prompting the deployment of [[fighter aircraft]] to intercept the object. The origin and purpose of the balloon are unknown, according to [[U.S.]] officials. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-68388453 (BBC News)]
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah clashes]]
**Two civilian paramedics and a Hezbollah militant killed in an Israeli strike on a Hezbollah-funded clinic in Blida]], [[southern Lebanon]].[https://www.barrons.com/news/hezbollah-says-2-paramedics-fighter-dead-in-israeli-strike-on-lebanon-632e6ec8 (Barrons)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Nanjing building fire]]
**At least 15 people are killed and 44 more injured during a fire at an [[Tower block|apartment block]] in [[Nanjing]], [[China]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/2/24/at-least-15-killed-in-fire-at-apartment-block-in-chinas-nanjing (Al Jazeera)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Israel–United States relations]]
**[[United States Secretary of State|U.S. Secretary of State]] [[Antony Blinken]] declares that [[Israeli settlement]]s in the [[West Bank]] are illegal under international law, overturning [[Foreign policy of the first Donald Trump administration|a policy]] instated under former [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]. [https://www.haaretz.com/us-news/2024-02-23/ty-article/.premium/u-s-effectively-reverses-pompeo-doctrine-on-legality-of-west-bank-settlements/0000018d-d707-db8c-a38d-df7fd4e00000 (''Haaretz'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Cannabis in Germany]]
**The [[Germany|German]] [[Bundestag]] votes to legalise recreational usage of cannabis for adults, making Germany the third European country to do so after [[Cannabis in Malta|Malta]] and [[Cannabis in Luxembourg|Luxembourg]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/02/23/europe/germany-cannabis-legal-parliament-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*Three women are killed during a [[mass stabbing]] at a [[brothel]] in [[Vienna]], [[Austria]]. A 27-year-old male suspect is arrested. [https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/three-women-found-stabbed-to-death-in-vienna-brothel%2C-police-say/72947097 (Swiss Info)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Senegalese presidential election]]
**[[President of Senegal]] [[Macky Sall]] states that he will leave the presidency in April, but does not give a specific date for the presidential election, which was postponed earlier this month. [https://apnews.com/article/senegal-elections-macky-sall-6967d1ca5ad4b53d2adf8a507873eb7b (AP)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Moons of Uranus]], [[Moons of Neptune]]
** Three new [[List of natural satellites|moons of the Solar System]] are discovered, one around [[Uranus]] and two around [[Neptune]], bringing their total known satellites to 28 and 16, respectively. [https://www.pbs.org/newshour/science/astronomers-spot-3-new-tiny-moons-around-neptune-and-uranus (PBS)]
